items.title: File Clark County business personal property return
items.description: Nevada business personal property declarations are due to the county assessor by July 31 (or 15 days after a county demand if later), even when the business has no assets.

items.title: File Washoe County business personal property return
items.description: Nevada business personal property declarations are due to the county assessor by July 31 (or 15 days after a county demand if later), even when the business has no assets. Declarations are filed through the county's online e-Dec system.
